name: Variants
description: Types an open JSON field of the type by the value of another of its fields: while by holds a value types lists, field, when it holds a value, is held to that type of the schema document as a field of the type is, unknown keys refused at every depth; while by holds another value or none, field holds none. A result whose shape differs per kind of step is refused when it is written in the wrong shape. The describe document and the create and update tools show each variant.

by.description: The type's own string or enum field, by JSON key, whose value picks the type.

field.description: The type's own field the variants type, by JSON key: a Generic.JSON field, or one of a scalar whose values are JSON objects.

types.description: By a value of by, the type of the schema document, besides the instance type, that field holds while by holds the value.
